title: 9.1 Using Normal Distributions

icans: I can use the 68-95-99.7 rule to find areas under a normal curve.
I can find probabilities for normally distributed data.
I can tell whether data are approximately normal and how skew affects the mean and median.

vocab: a ______________, symmetric distribution with mean μ and standard deviation σ
the bell-shaped graph of a normal _______________; total area 1
about 68%, 95%, and 99.7% of the data are within 1, 2, and 3 standard _____________ of the mean
not ____________: the mean is pulled toward the tail

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: The 68-95-99.7 rule: Within 1σ of the mean: ______% within 2σ: ______% within 3σ: ______%

blocks.stem: What percent of the area under the normal curve is shaded?

notes: Areas of the bands: Bands on each side: μ to σ: ______%, σ to 2σ: ______%, 2σ to 3σ: ______%, beyond 3σ: ______%

blocks.stem:
A normal distribution has mean μ and standard deviation σ. Find each probability.
a.  P(x ≤ μ − σ)        b.  P(x ≥ μ + 2σ)

notes: Skewed data: Skewed right: mean ______ median. Skewed left: mean ______ median.

blocks.stem: Does the histogram show data that are approximately normal? Is the mean greater or less than the median?
A normal distribution has a mean of 150 and a standard deviation of 10. Find P(x < 130).

tickets.stem: About what percent of normally distributed data are within 2 standard deviations of the mean?
A normal distribution has μ = 50 and σ = 5. Find P(x > 55).
